action: Written refusal under OA-ZYRA-328 to repair stale Profile component fixtures in this three-page build.
verdict: Demonstrably outside queue55 layout execution: both fail before entering or constructing any changed55 presenter. No exact old-baseline reproduction claim.

cases.case: component: Profile row targets and arrows compact=false
component: Profile row targets and arrows compact=true

proof_before55.fact: The fixture mounts only ZyraConceptProfilePresentation. onAction is actions.add; onSwitchRole is empty. No Navigator or real account-action coordinator is supplied.
The retained stack ends at the first await arrow(membership-manage), line401. It fails at the initial scroll, before subscriptions/unlocks arrow checks or any tap.
The first tap would occur later at line424; even there the action callback only appends to the list and cannot navigate to Compatibility Unlocks.
Profile _row generates ValueKey(concept_$id) and onTap merely calls the supplied onAction.
Current Profile membership row id is membership, so its real key is concept_membership. The fixture still seeks membership-manage.
Profile build composes its Profile header, cards and rows; it does not instantiate locked Compatibility, Unlocks catalogue or account Safety. Queue55 did not change this file.

limits: This proves the failures occur before55 layout can execute. It does not establish the exact commit that first introduced the stale fixture, or prove a historical full baseline result. The Profile tests were not rerun or repaired; the relevant inline catalogue test passes and has an explicit JSON case result.
